## Klausway — Weekly SEO Monitor
1. GSC 28d vs prior 28d (configurable properties)
2. Sitemap + sampled page health checks
3. Cautious OpenAI recommendations
4. Email support@klausway.com (or SEO_REPORT_TO)
5. Save history to Postgres
6. Optional urgent alerts with dedupe

**Inactive by default.** Connect Google OAuth with `webmasters.readonly`, set `GSC_N8N_CREDENTIAL_ID`, test via webhook, then activate.

parameters.query: SELECT site_id, robots_hash, robots_text, updated_at FROM n8n_seo_robots_snapshots;
SELECT id, issue_key, site_id, severity, last_alerted_at, resolved_at FROM n8n_seo_alert_state WHERE resolved_at IS NULL;

meta.notes: Import inactive. Create Google OAuth credential with webmasters.readonly and attach to GSC Search Analytics node. Default email: support@klausway.com
